Purpose.text: Weighted citizen identity, eligibility, status, warrant, vehicle, behavior, and roleplay data for police-mode checks.

Runtime.text: Select weighted pool values, apply consistency rules, then emit a unique citizen record with a replayable generation seed.

Principle.text: A vehicle hit belongs to the vehicle until the person identity is independently confirmed.
Witness, victim, medical, welfare, protected, administrative, and unavailable results are valid outcomes.
Use record indicates, reported, alleged, or requires confirmation until the game state is confirmed.

Description.text: Record returned clear for the supplied identity and jurisdiction.

Response.value: Complete the check and close professionally.

Description.text: All presented documents and answers agree with the query.

Response.value: Return documents and offer assistance.

Description.text: Visitor or tourist identity verified with no local adverse record.

Response.value: Use a service-oriented close.

Description.text: Prior medical or welfare call only; no enforcement alert.

Response.value: Offer medical or welfare assistance.

Description.text: Caller, witness, or reporting party only; no suspect designation.

Response.value: Protect witness information.

Description.text: Prior consensual community contact with neutral disposition.

Response.value: Treat history as neutral.

Description.text: A professional credential is verified with no adverse action indicated.

Description.text: A document is expired with no active arrest warrant.

Description.text: One or more identity fields do not match the document or database.

Response.value: Confirm respectfully; alias is not deception.

Description.text: Supervision note requests documentation but does not establish a violation.

Response.value: Confirm only when supported by policy and facts.

Description.text: General report match is incomplete.

Indicator.value: clothing, vehicle, time, or distance similarity

Response.value: Seek corroborating facts and record uncertainty.

Description.text: Possible concealed item or repeated hand-visibility concern.

Response.value: Give a clear safety instruction and act proportionately.

Description.text: Query returns a potentially active warrant or pickup.

Response.value: Verify before enforcement and notify supervisor as required.

Description.text: Person or vehicle substantially matches a current bulletin.

Indicator.value: distinctive clothing, vehicle, time, and direction

Response.value: Use safety tactics and confirm bulletin.

Description.text: Confirmed caution is relevant to the contact.

Response.value: Plan safety; history alone is not probable cause.

Description.text: Person is linked to a stolen vehicle investigation.

Indicator.value: plate or VIN hit and ownership conflict

Response.value: Separate driver and vehicle facts.

Description.text: Verified weapon concern is connected to the person or call.

Response.value: Create distance, communicate, and request units.

Description.text: Current intelligence provides an investigative lead.

Response.value: Use as lead only; group association is not proof.

Description.text: Person may be missing or endangered.

Response.value: Prioritize welfare and privacy.

Description.text: Identity is linked to impersonation or theft alert; holder may be victim.

Response.value: Use secondary verification and treat fairly.

Description.text: Non-criminal administrative notification or hold.

Response.value: Confirm authority and scope.

Description.text: Privacy or protection note limits disclosure.

Response.value: Minimize exposure and route to supervisor.

Description.text: Service or jurisdiction unavailable; no conclusion can be drawn.

Indicator.value: timeout, offline terminal, or partial record

Response.value: State result is inconclusive and retry or document.

Description.text: Age or vulnerability requires a safeguarded contact flow.

Indicator.value: possible juvenile, disability, or guardian request

Response.value: Use safeguarding procedures.

Description.text: Identity collides with a deceased or impossible record.

Indicator.value: death record, duplicate identity, or impossible dates

Response.value: Preserve records and verify before action.

Rule.text: Clean usually means none, except witness, victim, welfare, or administrative branches.
High alert may use a non-none warrant, but false-hit and identity-theft victim branches remain possible.
Medical, missing, juvenile, and vulnerability records prioritize welfare.
Stolen, uninsured, or unregistered vehicle does not automatically make driver the offender.
Identity collision requires secondary verification and may resolve as a victim.
Nervousness, clothing, neighborhood, occupation, race, gender, or model appearance never independently upgrades status.
Gang-associated model is visual context only and never establishes membership or probable cause.
Service model may be civilian, off-duty, employee, witness, or officer; do not auto-classify.
Unavailable service stays inconclusive and never becomes clean or high alert by inference.
Expired document can be a civil defect without creating arrest authority.
